description: Power-user generic query: run search_read on ANY Odoo model. Provide model (e.g. "product.template"), domain (Odoo list-of-triples, e.g. [["list_price",">",100]]), fields, and limit. Use when no specific tool above fits.

_apiKey.description: Odoo API key (Settings → Account Security → API Keys) or account password.

domain.description: Odoo search domain — a list of triples [field, operator, value], e.g. [["active","=",true],["name","ilike","acme"]]. Empty array [] matches all.

fields.description: Field names to return, e.g. ["name","create_date"]. Omit to let Odoo return its default field set.

url.description: Odoo instance base URL, e.g. https://mycompany.odoo.com (trailing slash optional). Works for Odoo Online and self-hosted.

name: odoo_query_model
